home.title: PDF tools
home.lead: Merge, split, reorder and convert PDFs.
home.local: Runs in your browser: files are never uploaded

merge.name: Merge
merge.desc: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order you choose, page by page.
merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.lead: Drag files or single pages to set the order of the merged PDF.

extract.name: Extract
extract.desc: Pick pages or ranges like 1-3, 7 and save them as one or several PDFs.
extract.title: Extract / split
extract.lead: Click pages or type ranges. Both stay in sync.

organize.name: Organize
organize.desc: Reorder, rotate and delete pages, then save the cleaned-up PDF.
organize.title: Organize pages
organize.lead: Drag to reorder. Rotate or delete page by page.

imagesToPdf.name: Images → PDF
imagesToPdf.desc: Turn JPG and PNG files into a PDF, with page size, orientation and margins.
imagesToPdf.title: Images → PDF
imagesToPdf.lead: One image per page, in the order shown. JPG and PNG.

pdfToImages.name: PDF → images
pdfToImages.desc: Export pages as PNG or JPG; several pages come as a zip.
pdfToImages.title: PDF → images
pdfToImages.lead: Choose the pages to export. Several pages download as a zip.

common.emptyOne: Drop a PDF here, or choose one.

merge.empty: Drop PDFs here, or choose them.

images.empty: Drop JPG or PNG images here, or choose them.

error.notImage: {{name}} isn't a JPG or PNG image: skipped.
error.failed: Something went wrong. Nothing was downloaded.
